atmosSubject: weatherx-hq/atmos master merge of PR #495 (NAM retirement review date), 2026-10-07, on top of PRs #496, #487 and #490 (observation pipeline: receipts). Moving from 18fb5074d7472ffc5549704c0874f6e35516cef5 spans 51 commits / 643 files; under data/, ops/ and requirements* 22 files changed. PR #490 (16): the five observation producers are independent and write a newest_record_at header (data/fetch_metar.py, fetch_synop.py, fetch_buoys.py, fetch_openaq.py; data/fetch_fires.py adds newest_acq and an opt-in --receipt/WX_FIRES_RECEIPT run receipt), new data/observation_freshness.py, new ops/observation_receipt.py (receipt weatherx-observation-refresh-v1), new ops/report-refresh.py, ops/bake-observation-points.sh strict/partial modes, ops/bake-weatherx.sh pins WX_OBSERVATION_* on its call, plus tests (data/test_fetch_fires_progressive.py, data/test_observation_freshness.py, ops/test_bake_gate_contract.py, ops/test_ci_efficiency.py, ops/test_observation_bake_contract.py, ops/test_report_refresh.py). PR #487 (7, CI-only for producers): data/run_ci_battery.py, data/test_run_ci_battery.py, ops/check_provider_exit.py (--allow-absent-images; run only by Atmos ci.yml), ops/test_check_provider_exit.py, ops/test_ci_efficiency.py, ops/commercial/test-real-v2-workload.mjs, and ops/weather-lab-ready.sh (its last two suites now run in parallel), which the whole bake runs as its non-blocking Weather Lab gate (WEATHER_LAB_GATE_BLOCKS_DATA unset in bake.yml); no other file the whole bake or the five-feed lane executes changed outside PR #490. PR #495 moves the NAM retirement review from 2026-10-06 12Z to 2026-11-03 12Z (NOAA SCN26-47 update AAC) in experiments/models/fetch_noaa_regional_sample.py and experiments/models/additional_source_contracts.json (plus their tests and docs); the regional NAM collectors refused on the old date. PR #496 (i18n gate) changes only app/, docs/ and the testing/suites.json i18n command. data/requirements.txt, data/requirements.lock, ops/platform/publish-r2-component.sh and the cycle-side five-feed contract are unchanged; the producers' new header keys are additive. Outside data/ and ops/, 562 app/ files changed (346 app/src, 171 app/e2e), including app/package.json and app/package-lock.json (new runtime dependency zod; devDependencies for Stryker, axe, size-limit, coverage, fast-check), so the whole bake's npm ci --prefix app installs a different tree before its blocking npx vite build (bake.yml). Atmos CI (ci run 37559295662, quality run 37559295576) is green at this SHA, but a passing whole bake at this pin is unverified until one runs.
